bullets.text: Under supervision, implemented reusable Python modules for the project workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.
Under supervision, used scikit-learn TF-IDF features and a logistic-regression classifier on public company report excerpts; evaluated a fixed held-out split using macro F-score and example errors.
Cleaned supplied metadata tables in pandas using provided steps, then plotted record counts with Matplotlib and inspected missing-value summaries with guidance.
As an individual contribution to supervised research, implemented reusable Python workflow modules and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Under supervision, compared dictionary coding with nonnegative-matrix-factorization topic exploration of public policy excerpts using scikit-learn; examined stability across repeated fits and inspected documents supporting each interpretation.
Under supervision, validated pandas merges with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and used Matplotlib to visualize how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
